response.overview: After the sudden death of their mother, teenage sisters Bets and Laura are forced to leave everything behind to live with their estranged grandparents. As they struggle to adapt to a fractured home marked by grief, silence, and long-buried disappointments, Laura discovers an extraordinary gift for music while Bets fights to protect her sister and hold onto her own dreams. A Minor Time is an intimate coming-of-age drama about sisterhood, resilience, and the healing power of hope in the face of profound loss.
response.title: A Minor Time
